address: 35 Mu 4, Phet Kasem Road, Khok Kloi, Takua Thung, Phang-Nga, 82140, Thailand
bio: Using heavenly recipes from Kedah, Malaysian Bak Kut Teh is a divine pork rib soup with Chinese herbs, served in a clay pot. The succulent slow-cooked meat simply slips off the bone. The chef is so confident about its tastiness, there’s a money-back guarantee for those who disagree!...
